hints.title: Alternating Difference Requirement
hints.text: Subarray differences must begin with positive one and alternate signs strictly.

hints.title: Consecutive Step Expansion
hints.text: For each starting point, extend while the difference matches alternating positive and negative one.

hints.title: Subarray Length Filter
hints.text: Record the longest qualifying stretch of length at least two, or return negative one if none exists.

hints.title: Subarray Pattern Code

complexity.notes: Linear scan checking alternating consecutive steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all pairs with full slice checks is redundant.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enforces initial step of positive one and alternating parity difference.
